1.explanation: The root of the problem is in src/menu/view/item.jsx’s render(): it unconditionally sets title={this.getTitle(children)} on every item, so even for non-string or composite children (icons + text) you get a duplicate tooltip. To fix this, you should make setting of the title attribute conditional—only add title when the children are pure text and need the hover tip, and omit it otherwise.
1.bug_scenario: In the current Menu implementation every Menu.Item (and its variants) always renders a title attribute based on the concatenated inner text. This causes an undesired browser tooltip to appear whenever you hover—e.g. in a Cascader or custom‐rendered Menu.Item with icons and text—showing duplicate or unwanted text. The user wants to remove that default title except when the Menu.Item’s children are a plain string (to preserve long‐text hover for truncated items).
